comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus release and relocate a mounted camera.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed-key insertion, collar rotation, relocking, and repeated cycling versus cam release, retaining-lip clearance, supported extraction, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable stops without bottoming or drift versus released camera upright on a pad with clearance, stability, and no drop.
comparison.reason: Shared release/retention primitives do not test the same ability; the candidate uniquely requires response-based tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits remain undeclared.
